coverage_policy: Existing frozen inventory is package-level coverage. It is not a requirement to author every outline or place all glyphs in one binary.
root_policy: One unified image governs new drawing and shows actual Baskerville comparison anchors. Original supplied font geometry governs reused roles.
distribution_policy: External user-supplied Storm fonts; no commercial outlines or binaries copied into the public AGPL payload.
custom_math_scope_note: Nine generated root math bases remain provisional pilot constructions; audit available Storm signs before production expansion.

native_greek_alternates.policy: Custom Greek is the default. Native Storm Greek is available only through explicit opt-in; alternate coverage does not close custom-design gaps.
native_greek_alternates.absent_variant_policy: hard error; never substitute a different shape

geometric_symbol_policy.arrows: One shared vector grammar for shaft weight, head profile, hooks and bars; calibrated to the unified root and math-rule weight. Derive related directions and semantic variants; no per-arrow image call.
semantic_gates: harpoon half-head differs from full arrowhead
two successive heads differs from double shaft
mapsto bar differs from ordinary tail
geometric_symbol_policy.image_cells: Invalid atlas arrow cells are quarantined, never traced as production references.
